name: Divine Luxe Esthetics
language_evidence: All Google/Birdeye reviews, Instagram captions, TikTok bio, and the entire Acuity Scheduling booking flow (menu, policies, welcome graphics) are in English.

location.status: AMBIGUOUS, resolved to city-only per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b (no exact street published)
resolution_notes: GlossGenius (divineluxeesthetics.glossgenius.com) is DEAD: it 302-redirects to the generic glossgenius.com marketing homepage, so it is NOT the active booking channel and could not be used as a source (contradicts the discovery brief's assumption that GlossGenius was current).
The business's ACTIVE booking system is Acuity Scheduling (https://divineluxeesthetics.as.me/, owner=25030427), confirmed live and returning real menu/pricing data.
Acuity's own uploaded welcome graphic states: 'WELCOME TO DIVINE LUXE ESTHETICS - BASED IN ORLANDO, FL - LUXURY LASH SERVICES EST. 2022'.

Acuity's own uploaded contact-info graphic states location as 'Orlando, FL (St. Cloud 34772)' and explicitly: 'Exact address will be sent to your email 72 hours prior to your appointment to safeguard privacy.' This is first-party confirmation that NO exact street address is publicly published by the business itself (private/home-based studio), independent of the Birdeye/Yelp/Facebook ambiguity.

The Instagram account's own display name/title is 'St Cloud Lash extensions & Lash Training' (still current as of Aug 2026 per fetched page title and photo alt text), which conflicts with the Acuity 'Based in Orlando, FL' framing.
Facebook page and Nextdoor listing both label the business 'Saint Cloud, FL' (Nextdoor's most recent activity shown was Nov 2024, i.e. dated).

Birdeye, Yelp, and BeautySchoolsDirectory.com all independently list '8803 Futures Dr Unit 4 Suite 202, Orlando, FL 32819' as the address; a separate Yelp search snippet surfaced a third candidate address ('4343 Hunters Park Ln, Orlando, FL') that was not independently confirmed.

Given two current first-party channels disagree (IG title says St. Cloud, Acuity says Orlando) and the business itself deliberately withholds its exact address for privacy, the site uses ONLY 'Orlando, FL' as the city (matching the majority of directory sources and the business's own Acuity graphic), no street address, no embedded map, and a real studio photo (wall signage) in place of the map, per FORGE-BRIEF section 0.b.

about: Divine Luxe Esthetics is licensed lash artist Bekah Romero's private lash studio, based in Orlando, FL and open since 2022 ('Luxury Lash Services Est. 2022' per the business's own booking page). Bekah specializes in wispy looks, customized lash sets, and lash mapping tailored to eye shape. She also offers private 1:1 lash extension training for aspiring lash artists (free 15-minute consultation call to start). The studio does not publish its exact street address publicly; it is shared by email 72 hours before a confirmed appointment, for privacy.

services.name: Free 15 min Consultation Call for Lash Courses

services_source: Extracted directly from the BUSINESS json embedded in the live Acuity Scheduling booking page (app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=25030427).
policies_note: $25 deposit required to secure appointment (applied to final total, non-refundable). Cancellations require 24h notice or 50% charge. 15-minute late grace period. Source: business's own Acuity policy graphics.

reviews.author: Gia
reviews.quote: I absolutely love getting my lashes done here! From the moment you walk in, you're welcomed into such a clean, relaxing, and professional environment.

reviews.author: Rosemarie Urena
reviews.quote: She had such a comfortable setup, made the whole process feel effortless and smooth, and overall it was such a great experience.

reviews.author: Maria Borrero
reviews.quote: You can tell she truly cares about her work and her clients. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Melanie Mercado
reviews.quote: Her space is beautiful, clean, and super relaxing And my lashes came out perfect, and exactly what I wanted.

reviews.author: Nashaly Douglas
reviews.quote: I've been getting my lashes done for years and this was the BEST service and result I've ever received. From setting up the appointment to my final results I can honestly say it was a 10/10 experience. My concerns about my eye shape were heard and the results show it!
reviews.source: Google (via business's own Acuity testimonial graphic, 'SEE MORE REVIEWS ON MY GOOGLE PAGE')

reviews.author: Daisha Laguna
reviews.quote: She did an amazing job. It was my 1st time doing lashes and I came here 3 days before my wedding and the classic customized look came out amazing. Truly has a gift. I highly recommend her.
reviews.source: Google (via business's own Acuity testimonial graphic)

brand_vibe: Soft luxury / dusty rose. The business's own Acuity booking theme uses buttonAccent #d7aeb5 (a warm dusty rose/mauve), consistent across its welcome, policy and contact graphics (cream/blush backgrounds, deep espresso-brown serif headings). Site palette derived by rotating the light-v2 template's plum-pink accent (#a04a72, hue 332) to hue 350 (matching the business's own declared #d7aeb5 hue) producing a distinct warm rosewood accent (#9d4957) rather than reusing lashbloom's exact plum-pink.
